[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Nova''' was a legendary [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and trailblazer who was sometimes dismissed as an urban legend. Said to fly across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Runner 309]]'', Nova was said to show up in the nick of time to save [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in trouble. His exploits were commonly told in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] across the galaxy, and were reported by everyone from [[Imperial Knight]]s to [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
